purpose: Weekend rentals per month, and how many weekend days each month had
sql: SELECT substr(start_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS rentals, COUNT(DISTINCT start_date) AS days FROM rentals WHERE strftime('%w', start_date) IN ('0', '6') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

purpose: Weekend rentals by zone, August and September
sql: SELECT s.zone, substr(r.start_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS rentals FROM rentals r JOIN stations s ON s.station_id = r.station_id WHERE strftime('%w', r.start_date) IN ('0', '6') AND r.start_date >= '2026-08-01' AND r.start_date < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY s.zone, month ORDER BY s.zone, month

purpose: Station closures that overlap August or September
sql: SELECT e.station_id, s.zone, e.start_date, e.end_date, e.note FROM station_events e JOIN stations s ON s.station_id = e.station_id WHERE e.event = 'closed' AND e.end_date >= '2026-08-01' AND e.start_date < '2026-10-01' ORDER BY e.start_date, e.station_id

purpose: Daily weekend rentals outside Riverside, August and September
sql: SELECT r.start_date, substr(r.start_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS rentals FROM rentals r JOIN stations s ON s.station_id = r.station_id WHERE s.zone <> 'Riverside' AND strftime('%w', r.start_date) IN ('5', '6') AND r.start_date >= '2026-08-01' AND r.start_date < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY r.start_date ORDER BY r.start_date

purpose: Email addresses of casual riders who rode in August but not in September, for a win-back offer
sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.email FROM riders d JOIN rentals r ON r.rider_id = d.rider_id WHERE d.plan = 'casual' AND r.start_date >= '2026-08-01' AND r.start_date < '2026-09-01' AND d.rider_id NOT IN (SELECT rider_id FROM rentals WHERE start_date >= '2026-09-01')
